state.title: naoqi_rest

part.text:
I stopped without reaching the red wall, so the task is not complete.

The robot went down the corridor and through several corners, but it kept drifting into the right-hand wall. Each time, the collision protection stopped it at about 0.3 to 0.4 m from that wall. I tried sidesteps to the left and forward moves at a few angles, and the red wall was only visible in brief glimpses through a gap ahead and to the left. I could not find a clear line to it.

The robot is now at rest in a crouch with its motors off, at about x 5.7 m, y 7.7 m from the start, facing roughly 66° left of the original direction. Battery is at 99%.

To finish, someone would need to check the layout near the gap ahead and to the left of the robot's last position. Guiding it by hand past that corner, or giving it a clearer route, would probably be needed. Once it is in view of the red wall, I can continue from there.
